scope: Complete native ordinary SensorHw::setExposureParams queue path: 244-byte exposure assembly, first-entry markers, replacement of old intermediate entries and consumed input count, interleaved with real native handle_sof and isolated native linear sensor-writer execution. Native DPCC side payload and input-count reset also asserted.
limitations: Pool allocation, smart-pointer operations, C++ list links, map slots, locking, delete, DPCC execution and logs are modeled boundaries; native queue/SOF control flow executes. Native sensor writer executes separately with descriptor/ioctl callbacks, including injected failures.
Submission success paths only, sensor already initialized, ordinary non-custom-I2C and non-test mode. Startup immediate writes and pool failures remain separate.
Rust pending capacity is explicitly 32 with preflight rejection; native allocation-failure partial mutation is not emulated.
No sensor writes, physical exposure timing or live feedback qualification.
